JPEG photographs from deployment SC1, collected with camera EM03. Files are stored in photos/SC1/. The literal filename prefix SC1_ identifies the deployment. YYYYMMDDHHMMSS gives the four-digit year, two-digit month, day, hour, minute and second, with hours 00 through 23 on a 24-hour clock. Each filename identifies a photograph at its recorded capture time. Device times have no UTC offset and were not automatically adjusted for daylight saving time. Use deployment_id and image_filename in photo_index.csv to link photographs to deployments.csv and associated observations. The .JPG extension denotes JPEG format.
